data.primary: Ausgrid Solar Home Electricity Data via verified provenance mirror if official links remain unavailable
data.energy_unit: kWh per half-hour; multiply by 2 for kW
data.controlled_load_channel: CL: add to feeder demand and separate fixed-price bill; not offset by battery in primary design
data.timezone: retain source clock convention; must confirm README before UTC conversion
data.heldout_policy: fixed ID hash before fitting; require enough jointly observed households; otherwise report smaller transfer study without duplication
data.missing_policy: no future interpolation; short gaps <= 2 slots use trailing same-slot seasonal median with missing flag; long gaps exclude whole paired feeder-day
data.evaluation_mask: identical across all controllers; main scoring on strict common clean days; report coverage and AUD/household/day, not incomplete annual bills; full calendar replay including source-estimated values is separately labeled sensitivity

forecast.primary_model: pooled MLP 128-64-48 with nonnegative PV output, capacity normalization and identical warm-start
forecast.load_forecast: one fixed statistical forecast shared by every objective-comparison arm
forecast.optional_architecture_replication: small LSTM only after main preflight
forecast.tuning_budget: same 6 validation configurations per learning objective; fixed final seed set
forecast.tariff_conditioning: train a DFL model per declared tariff or condition the model/loss on tariff; do not silently transfer objectives

battery.terminal_policy: day-ahead energy end equals starting energy; no silent daily state reset
battery.sensitivity: capacity 5/10/15 kWh, power 3/5 kW and degradation 0/0.01/0.02/0.04 examined in limited factorial subsets

tariffs.meaning: explicit synthetic fixed retail tariff scenarios; not historical customer contracts
tariffs.heterogeneous_arm: randomly assign fixed ToU and flat tariff at 50/50 using the frozen seed; bill comparison uses each household's own contract

dispatch.primary: daily 48-slot battery schedule, settled on realized net load with continuous energy state
dispatch.secondary: rolling 48-slot horizon updated every 6 hours on prespecified four seasonal weeks; hourly updating on a small timing check
dispatch.shared_tie_break: strictly convex epsilon quadratic regularization on BATTERY actions/states only, identical in every learned arm; no forecast-dependent grid-flow penalty
dispatch.null_effect_control: equal buy and sell prices each slot, unlimited bidirectional connection and forecast-independent battery constraints: PV/load forecast is only a cost constant, so unique battery actions must not change
dispatch.epsilon_scale: dimensionless after per-unit normalization; validate 1e-6/1e-5/1e-4 and deterministic randomized tie-break diagnostic

network.primary: IEEE European low-voltage feeder, 55 single-phase loads; benchmark transfer not reconstructed Ausgrid feeder
network.solver: OpenDSS or equivalent unbalanced AC solver, validated against supplied feeder reference
network.data_license: verify source terms before redistribution; old IEEE repository LICENSE is TBD
network.secondary: two SimBench LV topologies with ODbL/DBCL data attribution; balanced-model robustness only
network.mapping_seeds_scope: four seasonal weeks in frozen reference scenario, not ten full-year mappings per main cell
network.penetration_assignment: nested deterministic household selection shared across controllers

primary: common-clean-day electricity cost AUD per household per day
observed-period feeder import and export peak kW with coverage
voltage exceedance integral pu-hours with coverage
transformer overload duration hours with coverage
evaluation.annual_metrics: report only for a complete 365-day scenario replay; distinguish original estimated values from actual metered values
evaluation.stochastic_baseline: 20 joint block-residual paths with shared first-stage battery actions across all scenarios; grid settlements may differ; no path-specific clairvoyant actions
secondary: forecast MAE normalized by installed capacity
evaluation.comparison: DFL minus identical architecture MSE controller, paired on dates, households, mappings and seeds
evaluation.uncertainty: paired seasonal moving-block bootstrap of daily paired outcomes with 7-day blocks, 2000 resamples; 14/28-day sensitivity; network mappings and seeds reported separately
not_independent_units: random mappings as independent real networks
evaluation.practical_thresholds: design thresholds, not established empirical laws: 1% annual bill, 2% peak relative to baseline, and 0.1 percentage-point violation incidence; report absolute values and uncertainty

stop_if: novelty fully covered by closest paper
increment disappears after matching optimizer and tie-breaking
data channels cannot distinguish gross PV and consumption
DFL does not improve any decision criterion over fair statistical and robust baselines and provides no informative boundary result
